body:
> Project → Export → macOS preset. Set Binary Format → Architecture to x86_64 (or arm64).

This option is hidden and shouldn't be changed from UI, it's not supported by exporter / official templates.

But since x86-64 macOS is deprecated (next macOS version is arm64 only), it will be fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119708 (allows architecture selection, defaults to arm64 only).

> e.g. x86_64-only to distribute an unsigned build that runs under Rosetta without the arm64 code-signing requirement

arm64/universal export with ad-hoc signature which can be generated by exporter works the same as unsigned x86-64. x86-64 only builds lacks Metal support and should not be used as a substitute for universal binary.
